Kerala clarifies shipbuilding deal amid discussion on Tata's role

Kerala's Chief Minister has clarified details surrounding a Rs 10,000 crore shipbuilding investment, following discussions about the involvement of Tata. The clarification addresses the scope of the Mission Samudra investment and the specific roles of various entities, including Tata, in the project. This development highlights the importance of clear communication regarding significant industrial projects in the state.
